text:
auditor-Liu: Hi all — for a Monday SOC2 spot-check we need provenance and minimal forensic artifacts for an RBAC modification on 2026-01-15 that touched service account svc-redwood-worker and any KMS Decrypt activity within +/-30min. What are the smallest artifacts you can bundle?

zara_sec: We can produce: (1) git patch + commit id, (2) kube-apiserver audit entry for the binding change, (3) CloudTrail Decrypt CSV with SHA256 per row, (4) a signed manifest that lists each file + checksum.

devops-ryan: Timeline note: change applied by pipeline at 2026-01-15T08:42:10Z. kube audit shows a "patch" verb from user gitops.svc. We'll capture requestUID and clientIP.

carmen_compliance: Auditor wants chain-of-custody: who packaged, who uploaded, and any intermediate staging. We'll include packer username, host, packaging timestamp, and a presigned S3 URL.

auditor-Liu: Good. Also flag any KMS grants, cross-account decrypts, or unusual principal types. If possible add a one-line explanation per decrypt (why it likely occurred).

zara_sec: Early export: two decrypt events at 08:42:18Z and 08:45:02Z. Both show AssumedRole for svc-redwood-worker and an additionalEventData.grantId present for the first event. We'll annotate grantId and encryptionContext.job.

devops-ryan: Sample redacted export row (CSV): 
"eventTime,eventID,user,resources,enc_context,grantId"
"2026-01-15T08:42:18Z,evt-abc123,arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/redwood-svc-role/svc-redwood-worker,arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/aaaa1111,job=backfill,g-9f8e"

evidence-bot: pack job started (id pack-20260115-02). destination: s3://redwood-compliance/audits/soc2/2026-01-15/pack-20260115-02.tar.gz

carmen_compliance: Also include any tickets that reference svc-redwood-worker or the RBAC change within the day. We found JIRA INF-5230 (privilege-review) opened 2026-01-15 10:15; include redacted summary and link.

auditor-Liu: For verification, we'll need the GPG fingerprint used to sign the manifest and a short note about retention (auditor requires 90 days).

zara_sec: Manifest signed with key fingerprint: D4E1 2A9B 7C3F 88AA. Retention: objects will remain in compliance bucket for 120 days then archive to Glacier Deep. We'll attach lifecycle policy screenshot.

devops-ryan: Uploaded CSV + manifest and posted presigned links to the task. Manifest GPG-signed, includes per-file sha256. pack job completed: checksum sha256:7c5d2f...

evidence-bot: pack job succeeded (pack-20260115-02). object s3://redwood-compliance/audits/soc2/2026-01-15/pack-20260115-02.tar.gz

auditor-Liu: Received. I'll validate checksums and circle back if we need raw CloudTrail JSON or TLS-level traces. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
